_comment: JSON Resume data, loaded by jekyll-get-json (see jekyll_get_json in _config.yml).
The al-folio demo content (Albert Einstein, with a phone number and street address) was
removed. This site's CV page uses cv_format: rendercv, so it reads _data/cv.yml instead —
this file is kept only so the jekyll_get_json step has something valid to load.
Do not put a home address or personal phone number here: this repository is public.
